- Build a complete, playable 3D open-world shooter.
- Add a “GUN OF DESTRUCTION” main menu with Play, Locker, and Options.

- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

- Use a local practice lobby with AI opponents because no multiplayer backend is present.
- Play opens the existing lobby; Locker opens the loadout-focused lobby; Options opens settings.

### Completed
- Built the game lobby, HUD, AI opponents, weapons, destructibles, buildable cover, and expanded island landscape.
- Added menu and options behavior, including look sensitivity and graphics quality settings.

3. Re-run `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check`.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game title, main menu, lobby, and options markup.
- `style.css`: Menu, lobby, and settings presentation; current menu styling issue.
- `game.js`: Menu navigation, settings behavior, and gameplay logic.

- Changes are uncommitted; `git status` showed the project files as untracked.
- The game is served at `http://localhost:3002`.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed before the latest title correction.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D open-world shooter branded “GUN OF DESTRUCTION,” including driveable vehicles.
- Move the health bar to the top-left of the screen.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Use a local practice lobby with AI opponents because no multiplayer backend is present.
- Play opens the existing lobby; Locker opens the loadout-focused lobby; Options opens settings.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the lobby, HUD, AI opponents, weapons, destructibles, buildable cover, island landscape, and menu/options behavior.
- Added procedural tank, armored truck, and battle mech models, vehicle entry/exit, movement, bomb firing, projectile updates, and explosion damage.
- Added vehicle control hints and cleanup when starting, ending, or leaving a match.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` completed without errors.

### Active
- Place the health bar at the top-left; it currently appears in the bottom HUD.
- Test vehicle entry, driving, bombing, and exit in-browser.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Update `index.html` and `style.css` to position the existing health display at the top-left without obscuring other HUD elements.
2. Check the updated HUD in-browser and inspect the latest screenshot if needed.
3. Test vehicle entry with `E`, WASD driving, click-to-bomb, and exit.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: HUD markup, including the health display and control hints.
- `style.css`: HUD layout and responsive styles.
- `game.js`: Health updates, vehicle models, controls, projectiles, and gameplay loop.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked.
- Vehicle controls: approach a vehicle and press `E`; use W/S to drive and A/D to steer; click to fire bombs; press `E` to exit.
- The server responds at `http://localhost:3002`.
